title: Neuropathy Phenotyping Protocols - Nerve Conduction Velocity
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7rbhm2n

steps.title: Configure Device Settings
steps.instruction: Set the stimulation and recording parameters for motor and sensory tests.

substeps.instruction: Motor tests: Duration 0.02 ms, Range 25 mA, Low frequency filter 1 Hz, High frequency filter 10 kHz, Sensitivity 1 mV, Time 2 ms/div.
Sensory tests: Duration 0.02 ms, Range 25 mA, Low frequency filter 1 Hz, High frequency filter 10 kHz, Sensitivity 50 µV, Time 2 ms/div.

steps.title: Prepare and Anesthetize Animals
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the animal and manage body temperature throughout the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Monitor body temperature with a dermal temperature probe.
Maintain body temperature at 32ºC using a warming lamp during NCV.
Maintain body temperature at 37ºC after NCV using a warming pad.

steps.title: Perform Sciatic-Tibial Motor NCV
steps.instruction: Determine the sciatic-tibial motor NCV using bipolar electrodes and supramaximal stimulation.

substeps.instruction: Stimulate distally at the sciatic notch and distally at the knee.
Measure the resultant latency from initial onset to maximum negative peak using two points of stimulation along the nerve to calculate NCV.

steps.title: Determine Tail Motor Latency
steps.instruction: Measure the tail motor latency by stimulating the tail.

substeps.instruction: Stimulate distally along the tail at a recorded distance of 3 cm.
Measure latency from initial onset to maximum negative peak.

steps.title: Determine Tail Sensory NCV
steps.instruction: Measure the tail sensory NCV by stimulating the tail.

substeps.instruction: Stimulate proximally along the tail at a recorded distance of 3 cm.
Measure latency from initial onset to maximum negative peak.

steps.title: Clean Electrodes
steps.instruction: Maintain pathogen-free status by cleaning electrodes with 70% alcohol between animals.
